question: Bahadur Shah Zafar and his sons were arrested by the British officials from _________ in Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Humayun’s Tomb.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Bahadur Shah Zafar was the last Mughal emperor of India,** who was arrested by the British officials during the **Indian Rebellion of 1857.**
 
• The British officials arrested Bahadur Shah Zafar and his sons **from Humayun's Tomb in Delhi, where they were taking refuge.**
 
• **Humayun's Tomb is a UNESCO World Heritage Site** located in Nizamuddin East, Delhi, India. 
 
 
• It was built in the mid-16th century by Humayun's wife, Empress Bega Begum.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Safdarjung's Tomb** is another historical monument located in Delhi, which was built in 1754 by the son of Safdarjung, the prime minister of the Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah.
 
• **Jama Masjid is one of the largest mosques in India**, located in Old Delhi. It was built by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in the 17th century.
 
• ** Red Fort, also known as Lal Qila, is a UNESCO World Heritage** Site located in Old Delhi. 
 
 
• It was built by the **Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in the 17th century and served as the residence of the Mughal emperors until 1857.**
